newsitem.title: FINLAND: CULTOR TO SELL DAIRY UNIT FOR $6.5 MLN.
newsitem.headline: CULTOR TO SELL DAIRY UNIT FOR $6.5 MLN.

text.p: Finnish food and bakery group Cultor Oy said in a statement on Monday Cultor Food Science would sell its dairy ingredients business to Netherlands-based Royal Gist-Brocades N.V. for $6.5 million.

"Valued at $6.5 million, the transaction includes Cultor's microbial coagulants ... and cheese production cultures and media," Cultor said, adding annual net sales of the business to be divested were about $5 million.
The sale did not include production capabilities or employees, it said. Cultor Food Science planned to cease operations by April and offer the facility for sale.

"Divestiture of our dairy ingredients business represents further strategic progress as we work to refine our focus on specific food industry needs," Cultor Food Science president Hakan Lauren said in the statement.
